aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but incorrectly collapses several distinct investigation tests into one ambiguous changed factor.
issues: Changed factor mixes machine repair, vendor, suspension lot, cleaning, drying, and plasma tests.
Baseline/test conditions are unclear and sometimes parsed as row numbers or MC IDs.
Later relevant result rows and conclusion rows are omitted from the case.
Some cited rows lack supplied row text, limiting verification of extracted metrics.
Outcome grouping covers only part of the validation report.
requiredUserQuestions: Should this report be modeled as one root-cause investigation with multiple test factors?
What baseline should be used for each test factor if not explicit?
correctionPlan: Split or structure changed factors by tested condition: MC repair, vendor/laser, suspension lot, cleaning, drying, plasma.
Preserve subgroup keys such as date, MC number, lot, supplier, and process condition.
Include all relevant result rows through the final Nanosys/plasma comparison and conclusion rows.
Remove numeric row artifacts from changed-condition labels.
Recheck metric extraction and rates against each cited result row.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but coverage and row-text support are insufficient for final evidence.
